note: Minimum proposed coverage registry. Statuses are updated only after implemented work with evidence.

entries.requiredAction: Choose eye, correction and test distance; record the supplied result
entries.safeguard: Do not equate acuity with a percentage of total vision

entries.requiredAction: Interpret chart structure and a supplied letter score under a stated protocol
entries.safeguard: Do not claim an arbitrary font is a standardized chart

entries.requiredAction: Set working distance and document near notation with correction
entries.safeguard: Do not mix incompatible near-chart notations without a source

entries.activity: Very low acuity: CF, HM, LP and NLP
entries.requiredAction: Sequence a fictional low-vision assessment and document distance where relevant
entries.safeguard: Do not assign universal exact logMAR values to these categories

entries.requiredAction: Compare baseline and pinhole results and justify the next step
entries.safeguard: Improvement is evidence of an optical contribution, not proof that no disease exists

entries.requiredAction: Interpret a supplied contrast chart and compare with acuity
entries.safeguard: An illustrative display is not a calibrated clinical measurement

entries.requiredAction: Teach administration and interpret supplied validated results
entries.safeguard: Do not copy unlicensed plates or diagnose the student's color vision
evidence: administration sequence + text results; no plates; unscored

entries.requiredAction: Arrange illustrative tiles and interpret sourced example error patterns
entries.safeguard: Screen rendering is educational, not a standardized personal test

entries.requiredAction: Compare fictional monocular reports and correlate with other findings
entries.safeguard: Subjective asymmetry alone is not a complete diagnosis

entries.requiredAction: Map a virtual patient's central distortion or missing area
entries.safeguard: A normal illustrative grid result does not exclude macular disease

entries.requiredAction: Sweep a streak, change trial lenses, neutralize and remove working-distance power
entries.safeguard: The streak orientation and measured meridian are different

entries.requiredAction: Compare lenses with a fictional patient and state the endpoint
entries.safeguard: Do not reward indiscriminate over-minus correction
evidence: JccTool sphere check with declared over-minus response; fogging not modelled

entries.requiredAction: Position, flip and refine axis using an explicitly labeled convention
entries.safeguard: Do not use dot color as the only indication of power or axis

entries.requiredAction: Compare flips and maintain the required spherical-equivalent relationship
entries.safeguard: A ±0.25 D cross-cylinder does not mean 0.25 D cylinder magnitude

entries.requiredAction: Interpret fictional responses and connect them to chromatic focus
entries.safeguard: Do not treat a color response as a sufficient clinical endpoint

entries.requiredAction: Choose an appropriate case and interpret dissociated responses
entries.safeguard: Do not apply one protocol to every acuity or binocular-status combination

entries.requiredAction: Use working distance, distance correction and provided accommodation context
entries.safeguard: Age alone is not an automatic ADD prescription

entries.requiredAction: Compare results and explain when accommodation matters
entries.safeguard: Dilation and cycloplegia are not interchangeable concepts

entries.requiredAction: Check laterality, notation, quality and differences from other findings
entries.safeguard: An autorefractor printout is not automatically the final prescription
evidence: one authored printout in Patient B with caveat

entries.requiredAction: Focus simulated principal line sets and write a lens prescription
entries.safeguard: Measurement of an existing lens is not diagnosis of the wearer

entries.activity: Pupil size and anisocoria in light and dark
entries.requiredAction: Compare both pupils under controlled illumination
entries.safeguard: Do not infer RAPD merely from unequal resting sizes

entries.requiredAction: Illuminate one eye and record both responses
entries.safeguard: Model afferent input and efferent response independently

entries.requiredAction: Swing the light and compare the relative response
entries.safeguard: A RAPD is not a permanently dilated pupil

entries.requiredAction: Switch targets and compare distinct response contexts
entries.safeguard: Do not reuse the light-reflex animation as a near-response model

entries.requiredAction: Move the target and document limitation with patient laterality
entries.safeguard: Muscle actions and test positions must not be conflated

entries.requiredAction: Control target behavior and describe supplied eye-movement patterns
entries.safeguard: Do not create physiologic waveforms from arbitrary easing curves

entries.requiredAction: Inspect reflex positions and describe alignment
entries.safeguard: Reflex displacement must use the correct coordinate convention

entries.requiredAction: Adjust a virtual prism to a defined reflex endpoint
entries.safeguard: State the precise variant and which eye carries the prism

entries.requiredAction: Cover the fixing eye, watch the fellow eye, then observe uncovering
entries.safeguard: Specify the observed eye at each stage

entries.requiredAction: Break fusion and observe refixation as the cover alternates
entries.safeguard: Do not call the total dissociated deviation a pure manifest deviation

entries.requiredAction: Distinguish simultaneous from alternate prism-cover methods and neutralize
entries.safeguard: The selected method determines which deviation component is measured

entries.requiredAction: Rotate the rod and align a reported line and light using a declared convention
entries.safeguard: The observed line and rod cylinder orientation are perpendicular

entries.requiredAction: Set filter assignment and interpret a virtual patient's reports
entries.safeguard: Filter eye, distance and diplopia geometry must be explicit

entries.requiredAction: Explain disparity and interpret age-appropriate example results
entries.safeguard: A flat illustration without appropriate apparatus is not a validated stereo test

entries.requiredAction: Move a near target and record provided break and recovery observations
entries.safeguard: Do not turn a mouse-position threshold into a diagnostic cutoff

entries.requiredAction: Interpret a sourced or clearly schematic motility plot
entries.safeguard: Do not reduce every pattern to one diagnostic lookup label

entries.requiredAction: Maintain fixation, test monocular quadrants and document findings
entries.safeguard: Keep patient field coordinates distinct from retinal coordinates

entries.requiredAction: Move stimuli of specified properties and construct illustrative isopters
entries.safeguard: App stimulus parameters are not real instrument calibration

entries.requiredAction: Assess reliability, inspect plots and interpret a supplied pattern
entries.safeguard: Do not generate proprietary probability maps without normative data
evidence: generic labelled plots, authored reliability statements

entries.requiredAction: Map a fictional patient's reported boundary with fixation controlled
entries.safeguard: Do not confuse a response artifact with an established lesion

entries.requiredAction: Inspect lids, conjunctiva, sclera, cornea and pupil systematically
entries.safeguard: Observation is not equivalent to a complete slit-lamp examination

entries.requiredAction: Adjust light and identify the visible region
entries.safeguard: An illumination control must change what can actually be observed

entries.requiredAction: Adjust beam angle, width and focus to identify depth
entries.safeguard: A slit graphic pasted over a photo is not a depth model

entries.requiredAction: Choose illumination and identify a supplied media abnormality
entries.safeguard: Do not alter clinical-image pathology through cosmetic effects

entries.requiredAction: Compare peripheral chamber depth in a source-defined view
entries.safeguard: Do not present it as a replacement for gonioscopy

entries.requiredAction: Describe a standardized illustrative field and apply a verified grading system
entries.safeguard: Do not invent cell counts or grade boundaries
evidence: cells visible only with conical beam/dark/≥16×; no grading standard applied

entries.requiredAction: Inspect a pattern, locate the epithelial finding and form a differential
entries.safeguard: A staining pattern alone must not force an unsupported diagnosis

entries.requiredAction: Control a virtual blink and measure a defined tear-film interval
entries.safeguard: Timing is an authored simulation, not a measurement of the user

entries.requiredAction: Compare protocols and interpret a supplied strip result
entries.safeguard: Anesthetic status and protocol must be stated

entries.requiredAction: Choose a safe examination sequence and interpret supplied asymmetry
entries.safeguard: Do not invite unsupervised testing of the student's cornea

entries.requiredAction: Sequence the maneuver in a virtual patient and inspect the hidden surface
entries.safeguard: Do not reward manipulation when the case requires avoiding pressure

entries.requiredAction: Interpret a licensed clip or schematic leakage pattern
entries.safeguard: A negative result does not independently exclude open-globe injury

entries.requiredAction: Compare timed virtual tear clearance and document the observation
entries.safeguard: Do not equate all delayed clearance with one precise obstruction level

entries.requiredAction: Trace anatomy and interpret supplied reflux or passage observations
entries.safeguard: Conceptual training is not authorization for an invasive procedure

entries.requiredAction: Align virtual mires and interpret a supplied pressure with artifacts
entries.safeguard: Do not use measured pressure alone to diagnose or exclude glaucoma

entries.requiredAction: Compare use cases, technique prerequisites and supplied results
entries.safeguard: Do not assume every device shares an identical bias or scale

entries.requiredAction: Explain the measurement principle and interpret screening context
entries.safeguard: A screening value does not establish a complete glaucoma assessment

entries.requiredAction: Identify angle landmarks in a labeled original scene
entries.safeguard: Viewing geometry and angle-grading system must be declared

entries.requiredAction: Compare appositional and synechial example behavior
entries.safeguard: Use a reviewed constrained model, not arbitrary opening animations

entries.requiredAction: Interpret a supplied thickness value with the clinical context
entries.safeguard: Do not use a universal linear IOP correction formula

entries.requiredAction: Compare virtual pupils and describe asymmetry or leukocoria
entries.safeguard: A white reflex is a finding requiring evaluation, not one automatic diagnosis

entries.requiredAction: Select the view, navigate landmarks and record observed findings
entries.safeguard: A limited view does not establish a normal unseen retinal periphery

entries.requiredAction: Navigate a wider illustrative view and learn image orientation
entries.safeguard: Do not confuse virtual navigation with verified physical competence

entries.activity: Slit-lamp fundus examination with condensing lenses
entries.requiredAction: Compare viewing geometry and identify landmarks
entries.safeguard: Keep image orientation explicit rather than silently mirroring the retina

entries.requiredAction: Localize findings before naming disease and document only supported detail
entries.safeguard: Do not grade a disease stage from insufficient image coverage

entries.requiredAction: Scroll an authored stack, locate layers and correlate findings
entries.safeguard: Schematic slices are not real patient scans

entries.requiredAction: Inspect segmentation, scan quality and structure-function context
entries.safeguard: An isolated red sector is not an automatic glaucoma diagnosis

entries.requiredAction: Interpret sourced phases and compare leakage, staining and blockage
entries.safeguard: Timelines and patterns must come from an approved case

entries.requiredAction: Select an appropriate teaching indication and interpret supplied findings
entries.safeguard: Do not swap its information with fluorescein angiography

entries.requiredAction: Compare structural and flow information and inspect artifacts
entries.safeguard: Do not present it as identical to dye leakage imaging

entries.requiredAction: Describe a supplied signal pattern and correlate modalities
entries.safeguard: Signal appearance alone must not identify one disease universally

entries.requiredAction: Compare maps and regular versus irregular patterns with quality checks
entries.safeguard: A spectacle cylinder axis is not automatically a corneal steep axis

entries.requiredAction: Read principal corneal measurements and distinguish them from refraction
entries.safeguard: Corneal and total refractive astigmatism are not interchangeable

entries.requiredAction: Compare axial and anterior-segment measurements in authored examples
entries.safeguard: Do not fabricate a clinically usable IOL calculator

entries.requiredAction: Position a virtual probe and interpret an approved dynamic scene
entries.safeguard: Avoid pressure in scenarios where globe integrity is uncertain

entries.requiredAction: Compare supplied waveforms and explain which tissue response is assessed
entries.safeguard: Do not invent normal reference intervals or a screening diagnosis

entries.requiredAction: Interpret a supplied waveform in its protocol and clinical context
entries.safeguard: A waveform alone is not a universal lesion diagnosis

entries.requiredAction: Choose an age-appropriate method and interpret fixation behavior
entries.safeguard: Adult letter-chart logic does not apply to every child

entries.activity: Ptosis, lid measurements and levator function
entries.requiredAction: Measure a defined virtual scene and integrate pupil and motility findings
entries.safeguard: Do not infer the cause from lid height alone

entries.requiredAction: Place virtual landmarks and interpret supplied values and asymmetry
entries.safeguard: Reference ranges depend on method and population

entries.requiredAction: Calculate a constrained educational prism example and specify base direction
entries.safeguard: Distinguish prism diopters from lens diopters and degrees

entries.requiredAction: Compare protocol-specific fictional near responses
entries.safeguard: Do not claim a single age formula diagnoses presbyopia

entries.requiredAction: Interpret a virtual report with explicit lens orientation
entries.safeguard: A diagram of lines is not itself a binocular test on the student

entries.requiredAction: Change gaze and head position and compare a constrained case
entries.safeguard: The three-step pattern is not universally specific for one muscle disorder

entries.requiredAction: Compare supplied pre/post observations in a reviewed scenario
entries.safeguard: Do not turn one response into definitive ocular-myasthenia diagnosis

entries.activity: Corneal microbiology: test selection and specimen principles
entries.requiredAction: Choose investigations from case context and interpret supplied findings
entries.safeguard: Do not simulate unsupervised sampling as an actionable procedure

entries.activity: Orbital / visual-pathway CT and MRI interpretation
entries.requiredAction: Select a modality for a sourced case and correlate anatomy
entries.safeguard: Do not give MRI as a default when a metallic foreign body is a concern

entries.requiredAction: Interpret a source-reviewed protocol and its limitations
entries.safeguard: Do not provide unverified doses, pediatric use or timing assumptions
